# GitHub Copilot Release Instructions

When I say "prepare release vX.Y.Z":

- Compare to previous tag
- Group commits into the user-facing categories from changelog-instructions.md
- Write a short, exciting intro sentence
- Add migration guide if breaking changes
- Output ready for GitHub Releases + Twitter + newsletter
